newsitem.title: USA: AMP sees Q4 oper earns at around $0.43/shr.
newsitem.headline: AMP sees Q4 oper earns at around $0.43/shr.

text.p: AMP Inc said that fourth quarter operating earnings could be similar to the $0.43 per share posted in the third quarter.
The company said it will record special, mostly non-cash accounting charges in the fourth quarter. It said in a statement that it would provide details on January 22.

The company reiterated that fourth-quarter sales would likely be over $1.30 billion in the period a year ago, and $1.37 billion in the third quarter. The company said sales for the fourth quarter could reach a record $1.4 billion.

The company said it was seeking to reduce overall capital expenditures. "This year's total looks like less than $625 million -- down from $713 million last year -- and we're aiming for less than $600 million next year," it said.
It also said it created a key new function, Global Operations, to be headed by John Gurski, chief of its Europe, Middle East and Africa business, starting Jan. 1.
Succeeding Gurski is Tom DiClemente, formerly vice president, Southern Europe.

It said it was reviewing its businesses, and was aiming "to reduce non-value adding costs and improve productivity throughout the company," and was also determining "what specific underperforming businesses should be adjusted, phased out, or sold."
